Trump Urges Senate to Confirm Nominations After Midterm Elections

Following midterm election setbacks, former U.S. President Donald Trump has urged the Senate to expedite the confirmation of 161 pending nominations. This call comes as Trump continues to make public appearances and comments after the elections.
